subject: [PATCH v8 02/30] arm64: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds helpers for managing PMD-mapped anonymous huge pages (THPs) on arm64, specifically to keep them mapped across a swap round-trip. The new helpers wrap existing PTE-based functions and reuse the PTE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE flag to ensure exclusive access to the swapped-out page.
